newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China EB Tech in HK$78 mln new shr issue.
newsitem.headline: China EB Tech in HK$78 mln new shr issue.

text.p: China Everbright Technology Ltd said on Tuesday it will issue 117.1 million new shares to controlling shareholder Kenco Investments Ltd at HK$0.68 per share to raise a net of HK$78 million.
Kenco Investments is a wholly owned unit of China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd.
Kenco also agreed to place 64.42 million shares it held in China Everbright Technology at HK$0.68 each to independent institutional and private investors, it said in a statement.
The subscription and placing price represented a discount of about 17.1 percent to Monday's closing price of HK$0.82, the television and audio products maker said.
It said the placement, which is underwritten by Tai Fook Securities Co Ltd, is expected to be completed on Tuesday while subscription will be finished on or before January 28.

China Everbright Holdings' interest in the company held through Kenco and parties acting in concert will be unchanged from the current level of about 45 percent after the placement and share subscription, it said.
About HK$55 million of the net proceeds will be used to reduce the group's borrowings, with the balance used as general working capital, China Everbright said.
